verses.original: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ עַלְמ֥וּת לַבֵּ֗ן מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ אוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל־ לִבִּ֑י אֲ֝סַפְּרָ֗ה כָּל־ נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ‘al·mūṯ lab·bên miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’ō·w·ḏeh Yah·weh bə·ḵāl lib·bî ’ă·sap·pə·rāh kāl- nip̄·lə·’ō·w·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: For the choirmaster To the tune of “The Death of the Son A Psalm of David I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart I will recount all Your wonders
verses.literalPt: EU te louvarei, SENHOR, com todo o meu coração; contarei todas as tuas maravilhas.

verses.original: אֶשְׂמְחָ֣ה וְאֶעֶלְצָ֣ה בָ֑ךְ אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה שִׁמְךָ֣ עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ’eś·mə·ḥāh wə·’e·‘el·ṣāh ḇāḵ ’ă·zam·mə·rāh šim·ḵā ‘el·yō·wn
verses.literal: I will be glad and rejoice in You I will sing praise to Your name O Most High
verses.literalPt: Em ti me alegrarei e saltarei de prazer; cantarei louvores ao teu nome, ó Altíssimo.

verses.original: בְּשׁוּב־ אוֹיְבַ֥י אָח֑וֹר יִכָּשְׁל֥וּ וְ֝יֹאבְד֗וּ מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·šūḇ- ’ō·wy·ḇay ’ā·ḥō·wr yik·kā·šə·lū wə·yō·ḇə·ḏū mip·pā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: When my enemies retreat . . . they stumble and perish before You
verses.literalPt: Porquanto os meus inimigos retornaram, caíram e pereceram diante da tua face.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ עָ֭שִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטִ֣י וְדִינִ֑י יָשַׁ֥בְתָּ לְ֝כִסֵּ֗א שׁוֹפֵ֥ט צֶֽדֶק׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘ā·śî·ṯā miš·pā·ṭî wə·ḏî·nî yā·šaḇ·tā lə·ḵis·sê šō·w·p̄êṭ ṣe·ḏeq
verses.literal: For You have upheld my just cause You sit on Your throne judging righteously
verses.literalPt: Pois tu tens sustentado o meu direito e a minha causa; tu te assentaste no tribunal, julgando justamente;

verses.original: גָּעַ֣רְתָּ ג֭וֹיִם אִבַּ֣דְתָּ רָשָׁ֑ע שְׁמָ֥ם מָ֝חִ֗יתָ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.transliteration: gā·‘ar·tā ḡō·w·yim ’ib·baḏ·tā rā·šā‘ šə·mām mā·ḥî·ṯā lə·‘ō·w·lām wā·‘eḏ
verses.literal: You have rebuked the nations You have destroyed the wicked You have erased their name forever and ever
verses.literalPt: Repreendeste as nações, destruíste os ímpios; apagaste o seu nome para sempre e eternamente.

verses.original: הָֽאוֹיֵ֨ב׀ תַּ֥מּוּ חֳרָב֗וֹת לָ֫נֶ֥צַח וְעָרִ֥ים נָתַ֑שְׁתָּ אָבַ֖ד זִכְרָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ō·w·yêḇ tam·mū ḥo·rā·ḇō·wṯ lā·ne·ṣaḥ wə·‘ā·rîm nā·ṯaš·tā ’ā·ḇaḏ ziḵ·rām hêm·māh
verses.literal: The enemy . . . has come to eternal ruin and You have uprooted their cities the very memory of them has vanished
verses.literalPt: Oh! inimigo! acabaram-se para sempre as assolações; e tu arrasaste as cidades, e a sua memória pereceu com elas.

verses.original: וַֽ֭יהוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם יֵשֵׁ֑ב כּוֹנֵ֖ן לַמִּשְׁפָּ֣ט כִּסְאֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh lə·‘ō·w·lām yê·šêḇ kō·w·nên lam·miš·pāṭ kis·’ōw
verses.literal: But the LORD abides forever He has established His throne for judgment
verses.literalPt: Mas o SENHOR está assentado perpetuamente; já preparou o seu tribunal para julgar.

verses.original: וְה֗וּא יִשְׁפֹּֽט־ תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק יָדִ֥ין לְ֝אֻמִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū yiš·pōṭ- tê·ḇêl bə·ṣe·ḏeq yā·ḏîn lə·’um·mîm bə·mê·šā·rîm
verses.literal: He judges the world with justice He governs the people with equity
verses.literalPt: Ele mesmo julgará o mundo com justiça; exercerá juízo sobre povos com retidão.

verses.original: וִ֘יהִ֤י יְהוָ֣ה מִשְׂגָּ֣ב לַדָּ֑ךְ מִ֝שְׂגָּ֗ב לְעִתּ֥וֹת בַּצָּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wî·hî Yah·weh miś·gāḇ lad·dāḵ miś·gāḇ lə·‘it·tō·wṯ baṣ·ṣā·rāh
verses.literal: The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed a stronghold in times of trouble
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR será também um alto refúgio para o oprimido; um alto refúgio em tempos de angústia.

verses.original: וְיִבְטְח֣וּ בְ֭ךָ יוֹדְעֵ֣י שְׁמֶ֑ךָ כִּ֤י לֹֽא־ עָזַ֖בְתָּ דֹרְשֶׁ֣יךָ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yiḇ·ṭə·ḥū ḇə·ḵā yō·wḏ·‘ê šə·me·ḵā kî lō- ‘ā·zaḇ·tā ḏō·rə·še·ḵā Yah·weh
verses.literal: Those who know Your name trust in You for You, O LORD have not forsaken those who seek You
verses.literalPt: Em ti confiarão os que conhecem o teu nome; porque tu, SENHOR, nunca desamparaste os que te buscam.

verses.original: זַמְּר֗וּ לַ֭יהוָה יֹשֵׁ֣ב צִיּ֑וֹן הַגִּ֥ידוּ בָ֝עַמִּ֗ים עֲלִֽילוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: zam·mə·rū Yah·weh yō·šêḇ ṣî·yō·wn hag·gî·ḏū ḇā·‘am·mîm ‘ă·lî·lō·w·ṯāw
verses.literal: Sing praises to the LORD who dwells in Zion proclaim His deeds among the nations
verses.literalPt: Cantai louvores ao SENHOR, que habita em Sião; anunciai entre os povos os seus feitos.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ דֹרֵ֣שׁ דָּ֭מִים אוֹתָ֣ם זָכָ֑ר לֹֽא־ שָׁ֝כַ֗ח צַעֲקַ֥ת עֲנִיִּים׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḏō·rêš dā·mîm ’ō·w·ṯām zā·ḵār lō·šā- šā·k̲aḥ ṣa·‘ă·qaṯ ʿă·nī·yīm
verses.literal: For the Avenger of bloodshed remembers He does not ignore . . . the cry of the afflicted
verses.literalPt: Pois quando inquire do derramamento de sangue, lembra-se deles: não se esquece do clamor dos aflitos.

verses.original: חָֽנְנֵ֬נִי יְהוָ֗ה רְאֵ֣ה עָ֭נְיִי מִשֹּׂנְאָ֑י מְ֝רוֹמְמִ֗י מִשַּׁ֥עֲרֵי מָֽוֶת׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·nə·nê·nî Yah·weh rə·’êh ‘ā·nə·yî miś·śō·nə·’āy mə·rō·wm·mî miš·ša·‘ă·rê mā·weṯ
verses.literal: Be merciful to me O LORD see how my enemies afflict me Lift me up from the gates of death
verses.literalPt: Tem misericórdia de mim, SENHOR, olha para a minha aflição, causada por aqueles que me odeiam; tu que me levantas das portas da morte;

verses.original: לְמַ֥עַן אֲסַפְּרָ֗ה כָּֽל־ תְּהִלָּ֫תֶ֥יךָ בְּשַֽׁעֲרֵ֥י בַת־ צִיּ֑וֹן אָ֝גִ֗ילָה בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an ’ă·sap·pə·rāh kāl- tə·hil·lā·ṯe·ḵā bə·ša·‘ă·rê ḇaṯ- ṣî·yō·wn ’ā·ḡî·lāh bî·šū·‘ā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: that I may declare all Your praises that within the gates of Daughter Zion I may rejoice in Your salvation
verses.literalPt: Para que eu conte todos os teus louvores nas portas da filha de Sião, e me alegre na tua salvação.

verses.original: טָבְע֣וּ ג֭וֹיִם בְּשַׁ֣חַת עָשׂ֑וּ בְּרֶֽשֶׁת־ ז֥וּ טָ֝מָ֗נוּ נִלְכְּדָ֥ה רַגְלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ṭā·ḇə·‘ū ḡō·w·yim bə·ša·ḥaṯ ‘ā·śū bə·re·šeṯ- zū ṭā·mā·nū nil·kə·ḏāh raḡ·lām
verses.literal: The nations have fallen into a pit of their making their feet are caught in the net . . . they have hidden
verses.literalPt: Os gentios enterraram-se na cova que fizeram; na rede que ocultaram ficou preso o seu pé.

verses.original: נ֤וֹדַ֨ע׀ יְהוָה֮ מִשְׁפָּ֪ט עָ֫שָׂ֥ה בְּפֹ֣עַל כַּ֭פָּיו נוֹקֵ֣שׁ רָשָׁ֑ע הִגָּי֥וֹן סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: nō·w·ḏa‘ Yah·weh miš·pāṭ ‘ā·śāh bə·p̄ō·‘al kap·pāw nō·w·qêš rā·šā‘ hig·gā·yō·wn se·lāh
verses.literal: The LORD is known by the justice He brings the wicked are ensnared by the work of their hands Higgaion Selah
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR é conhecido pelo juízo que fez; enlaçado foi o ímpio nas obras de suas mãos. (Higaiom; Selá.)

verses.original: יָשׁ֣וּבוּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים לִשְׁא֑וֹלָה כָּל־ גּ֝וֹיִ֗ם שְׁכֵחֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: yā·šū·ḇū rə·šā·‘îm liš·’ō·w·lāh kāl- gō·w·yim šə·ḵê·ḥê ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: The wicked will return to Sheol all the nations who forget God
verses.literalPt: Os ímpios serão lançados no inferno, e todas as nações que se esquecem de Deus.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א לָ֭נֶצַח יִשָּׁכַ֣ח אֶבְי֑וֹן תִּקְוַ֥ת עֲנָוִים תֹּאבַ֥ד לָעַֽד׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō lā·ne·ṣaḥ yiš·šā·ḵaḥ ’eḇ·yō·wn tiq·waṯ ʿă·nå̄·wīm tō·ḇaḏ lā·‘aḏ
verses.literal: For the needy will not always be forgotten nor the hope of the oppressed forever dashed
verses.literalPt: Porque o necessitado não será esquecido para sempre, nem a expectação dos pobres perecerá perpetuamente.

verses.original: קוּמָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אַל־ יָעֹ֣ז אֱנ֑וֹשׁ יִשָּׁפְט֥וּ ג֝וֹיִ֗ם עַל־ פָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: qū·māh Yah·weh ’al- yā·‘ōz ’ĕ·nō·wōš yiš·šā·p̄ə·ṭū ḡō·w·yim ‘al- pā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: Rise up O LORD do not let man prevail let the nations be judged in Your presence
verses.literalPt: Levanta-te, SENHOR; não prevaleça o homem; sejam julgados os gentios diante da tua face.

verses.original: שִׁ֘יתָ֤ה יְהוָ֨ה׀ מוֹרָ֗ה לָ֫הֶ֥ם יֵדְע֥וּ גוֹיִ֑ם אֱנ֖וֹשׁ הֵ֣מָּה סֶּֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: šî·ṯāh Yah·weh mō·w·rāh lā·hem yê·ḏə·‘ū ḡō·w·yim ’ĕ·nō·wōš hêm·māh se·lāh
verses.literal: Lay terror upon them, O LORD let the nations know they are but men . . . Selah
verses.literalPt: Põe-os em medo, SENHOR, para que saibam as nações que são formadas por meros homens. (Selá.)
